intro.title: Welcome to TryCast
intro.body: You predict the competition's matches, and so do your mates. In the end, only one of you tops the table.

predictions.title: A prediction is a score
predictions.body: Call the exact score you expect. Nothing to submit: your entry saves itself, and locks at kick-off.
predictions.bonus: Tick the attacking bonus if you think a team will score at least four tries. Get it right and it pays; get it wrong and it costs 10 points.

leagues.title: Leagues are where it's at
leagues.body: Create yours and share its 8-character code, or join your mates'. You can also play without a league: your points still count overall.

notifications.title: Never miss a kick-off
notifications.body: We remind you before each match, and let you know as soon as your points are in.
